entities.name: Kinesis

entities.name: Kinesis Firehose
entities.rationale: Matches detected AWS icon at center=(1020,205) labeled 'KINESIS FIREHOSE', routing streaming data to storage and analytics.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Matches detected AWS icon at center=(1025,523) labeled 'S3', storing raw data persistently.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.rationale: Matches detected AWS icon at center=(1289,210) labeled 'REDSHIFT', serving as the data warehouse for analytics.

entities.name: QuickSight

visual_connections.description: An arrow points from the Smart TV sketch to Kinesis representing streaming logs, performance telemetry, and user data.
An arrow directs incoming stream data from Kinesis Data Streams into Kinesis Firehose.
An arrow points downward from Kinesis Firehose directly into the S3 bucket for long-term raw data storage.
An arrow points rightward from Kinesis Firehose into Amazon Redshift to load processed data.
An arrow points downward from Redshift to QuickSight for querying and dashboard reporting.
